name: Urwa ibn Hizam
bio: Urwa was a poet of the Banu Udhra whose verses kept his name beside that of his cousin Afra. Al-Zirikli relates that his uncle brought them up together and that Urwa went to Yemen to raise her bridewealth, only to find her married when he returned. In one account he visits her in the Balqa, receives her husband’s hospitality and falls gravely ill on the journey home. Al-Zirikli places his death around 30 AH (650 CE) and his grave in Wadi al-Qura.
